method: Expected move = (ATM call mid + ATM put mid) for the first expiration on or after the report date (strictly after it for after-close or unconfirmed-time reports, since a same-day expiry settles before the release), divided by the stock's last regular-session trade price. Mid = (bid+ask)/2.
selection: Notable, widely held, or high-volume US-domiciled companies reporting this week, curated by hand (US = headquartered in a US state per Robinhood's company profile; foreign issuers and ADRs are excluded).

featured_basis: two largest reporters by Robinhood market cap
cards_method: Latest quarter: Robinhood quarterly financials (revenue, net income, net margin) and the most recent reported 'actual' EPS from Robinhood earnings results (may be an adjusted, non-GAAP figure). Correlated stocks: Pearson correlation of 65 daily close-to-close returns (split-adjusted regular-session closes from Robinhood) against a hand-picked candidate list of same-sector stocks and ETFs; top 4 stocks and top 3 ETFs shown. Correlation is not causation and says nothing about the earnings reaction.
anticipated_method: Ranked by options activity: total open interest across all listed expirations plus the latest session's total options volume (contracts), from Robinhood market data retrieved Oct 17, 2026, 1:29 AM ET. A proxy for trader attention, not a forecast; names with missing data are listed last.
past_moves_method: Past earnings moves: close of the last session before the report to the close of the first session after it (before-open reports: prior close -> report-day close; after-close reports: report-day close -> next close), using Robinhood earnings-results dates/timing and split-adjusted daily closes; up to the last 8 reported quarters. Ratio = this week's implied move / average absolute past move (shown when at least 4 past reports are available; >=1.15 bigger, <=0.85 smaller than usual). Non-directional; not a prediction or advice.
